fieldValues.title: An export can strip chosen types of records
fieldValues.move: Let an export leave out chosen types of records, comments first, so the file shared with a reader never holds them.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not decide what context an agent reading the stripped file should still have (vignette f32cc637). Attached source documents are not records, and RFC-026 carries them with any record that cites them, so stripping a type does not remove them from a record that stays. It does nothing for what a reader sees (SP-150), and it does not cover muSrs renders, the original case of SP-124.
fieldValues.falsifier: A stripped essay still exposes comment text anywhere in the file, or fails validation because the removed records leave relations or containers dangling.
source_ref: srs-web main 8b2fedb, src/lib/essay/essay-document.ts: refreshBundle already chooses members and exportSlice writes them
Trial 2026-11-04 on a scratch copy of muSrs: a container of the essay, its paragraphs and what they cite sliced to 31 instances and 24 relations, no comment text, 0 validation errors
Spec invariant I-151: a slice must include the root's effective member set, so a type filter inside slice export needs an RFC-026 amendment
fieldValues.return_when: Writers need to choose record by record what stays, rather than removing fixed types.
